market_view: Calm regime: VIX 16.5 and falling, dollar firm, 10-year yield 4.4%. Oil, gold and uranium are in sharp drawdowns while semiconductors and health care sit near highs; no concrete edge on any family.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI is down 25% in 20 days and 38% in 60 days. A falling driver is not a reason to be long, and a rebound guess is not a reason either. XOM is a coin flip, with earnings season ahead.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is down 10% in 20 days with a firm dollar and yields above 4.4%, which are headwinds for NEM. The Q2 results call is only an announcement. No concrete reason to be long.

chips.reasoning: The sector ETF is up 67% in 60 days and sits near its high, but that move is priced in and NVDA has lagged. Headlines are generic AI news with no concrete catalyst. No selection rule applies.

pharma.reasoning: LLY is up 11% in 20 days and near its high. The sector driver is weak and the stock moves on its own news; the headlines (FDA peptide panel, COVID page) give no clear catalyst.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is mixed and FCX is 12% below its high. The Cameco Cigar Lake suspension is a one-off incident that mostly affects CCJ, not the leader FCX. No clear reason to be long.

would_change_my_mind: A specific scheduled catalyst or clearly mispriced event for a leader, or a stress-regime reversal giving a concrete reason.

handoff.what_changed: First run with no previous handoff. All five families are flat. Oil, gold and uranium are in deep drawdowns, while semiconductors and health care sit near highs.

oil_gas.why: WTI crashed 38% in 60 days; no concrete reason for XOM long.

gold_miners.why: Gold is in a downtrend with a firm dollar and high yields; no edge for NEM.

chips.why: Sector rally is priced in; NVDA has no specific catalyst.

pharma.why: LLY is near its high and there is no named catalyst.

copper_uranium.why: Mixed copper; the Cigar Lake news hits CCJ rather than FCX.
